stories.story: Sam wanted to eat the bread, but a kitten shivered on a high ledge. Sam said, “The kitten needs help.” Mum said, “I can lower the basket.” Sam said, “I can share the bread.” Sam put the bread in the basket. Mum carried the basket to the window, and she lowered the basket to the ledge with the rope. Sam waited because the kitten was frightened. The kitten entered the basket, and it ate the bread. Mum lowered the basket to the garden with the rope. Sam carried the kitten into the cottage, and he wrapped the kitten in the warm blanket. Sam was hungry, but the kitten rested in the warm blanket.
